options.name: copies
options.description: The number of copies of the logical volume. Maximum copies are 3.

options.name: lv
options.description: The name of the logical volume.

options.name: lv_type
options.description: The type of the logical volume.

options.name: opts
options.description: Free-form options to be passed to the mklv command.

options.name: policy
options.description: Sets the interphysical volume allocation policy. V(maximum) allocates logical partitions across the maximum number of physical volumes. V(minimum) allocates logical partitions across the minimum number of physical volumes.

options.name: pvs
options.description: A list of physical volumes, for example V([hdisk1, hdisk2]).

options.name: size
options.description: The size of the logical volume with one of the [MGT] units.

options.name: state
options.description: Control if the logical volume exists. If V(present) and the volume does not already exist then the O(size) option is required.

options.name: vg
options.description: The volume group this logical volume is part of.
